label: Boutique Hotels
prompt_notes: Focus on character, design, and intimate scale of boutique properties. Do not invent prices.

label: Free Cancellation
prompt_notes: Focus on flexible booking and peace of mind for travelers with changing plans.

label: Breakfast Included
prompt_notes: Focus on the convenience and value of having breakfast arranged.

label: Design Hotels
prompt_notes: Focus on architecture, interiors, and the aesthetic experience of staying in a design-led property.

label: Aparthotels
prompt_notes: Focus on space, self-catering kitchens, and longer-stay flexibility.

label: Top Rated
prompt_notes: Focus on guest satisfaction and high review scores rather than price comparisons.

label: Well Located
prompt_notes: Focus on central location, walkability, and access to city highlights.

label: With Pool
prompt_notes: Focus on pool access as a priority amenity for leisure travelers.

label: Extended Stay
prompt_notes: Focus on weekly stays, self-catering, and the practical comforts of longer-term accommodation.

label: Under $150
prompt_notes: Focus on value and mid-range options without making specific rate claims.
